text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Increase in child abuse. The government does not have enough inspectors to check child abuse, and many people appear to be reluctant to report abuse.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant welcomes growth of socialism in Europe and says the European Union is realising why Malta needs close relations with the EU, but not membership. The Maltese Labour government froze Malta's six-year-old application to join the EU last year saying it was economically better for Malta to have close relations with the EU without membership since several EU regulations were not suitable for a small island state.
- Average price of medicines has risen 27 percent in the past six months.
